ana (docs): opened PR with concise migration + examples for function/tool calling -> structured output. please review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/540

kevin (eng): quick skim. runtime emits `tool_call` now, right? docs should show how to accept older `tool` keys too.

ana (docs): yes canonical is `tool_call`. PR includes a tiny shim and a one-liner grep/sed for repo migration.

sam (ml): add a short schema snippet and a Python/JS parse example that explicitly uses json.loads/JSON.parse with try/catch. avoid implying SDK auto-parses.

ana (docs): added schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"tool_call":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"arguments":{"type":"string"}},"required":["name","arguments"]}}} and simple code samples.
\nkevin (eng): also request a unit-test suggestion: test both structured `tool_call` and free-form plain text. include a note about using jsonschema to validate before invoking external tools.
\nci-bot: label added: area:structured-output, needs-review  preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/540

ana (docs): updated with test suggestion + changelog one-liner. merging after CI. thanks!
